# Workspace instructions

- Keep file encryption and decryption entirely in the browser using Web Crypto; never send file bytes or passphrases to the Flask server.
- Clearly label the rate-limit visualizer as a simulation, passive packet capture as alert-only, and the persistent local hash-linked audit database as not independently immutable or a blockchain.
- Avoid storing secrets, adding authentication claims, or presenting this prototype as production-ready security.
- Keep deployment portable with Docker Compose, Nginx edge limits, named-volume metadata persistence, automatic local snapshots, and Windows local-run steps.
- Add or update tests when changing backend behavior.
